desc:
⚔️ Command a whole medieval army of thousands of soldiers and lead it to victory!

Pick your nation, muster your troops and fight big real-time battles. Knights charge, archers loose their arrows and peasants hold the line - every order is yours!

🏰 8 NATIONS - England, France, the Holy Roman Empire, Byzantium, Egypt, the Ottomans, Genoa and Jerusalem
🛡️ YOUR ARMY - knights, archers, crossbowmen, spearmen and more, different for every nation
👑 FAMOUS GENERALS - ride into battle with Joan of Arc and other legends
📜 HISTORICAL BATTLES - can you win Agincourt, 1415?
🏆 COMPETITIVE PLAY - fight real players and climb the ranks
🤝 CUSTOM BATTLES - team up with friends or add robots, up to 6 players
⚒️ UNLOCK & UPGRADE - earn crystals, unlock new nations and make your units stronger at the Blacksmith
🎁 Daily rewards!

👍 Like and favorite to get updates!
